root_cause_hypothesis: validate_code(mode="references") has no model of X++ KERNEL types, which exist only in the runtime and never as AOT metadata. Every direct-SQL member the case requires is a kernel symbol (Connection, Statement, ResultSet, SqlParams, DictTable, DbBackend, CodeAccessPermission, SqlStatementExecutePermission); get_object_info/search/batch_get_info return "not found" for all of them. The validator flagged exactly the two used in Type::Member position - DbBackend::Sql (reported as "unknown-static-member ... checked inheritance chain and extensions", a misleading message for a type that does not exist in the index at all) and CodeAccessPermission::revertAssert - while silently passing the same unknown types when they appear as local-variable declarations or in new X(). So the gate is both a false negative (any code using the documented direct-SQL escape hatch is told its identifiers do not exist) and internally inconsistent (unknown kernel type tolerated as a declaration, rejected as a static-call receiver). The code that tripped the gate compiled with 0 errors and 0 BP warnings, and every flagged member was independently proven live by find_references (DbBackend: 20 Foundation call sites; CodeAccessPermission::revertAssert in CustVendAgingCalculation.executeSql, DimensionValidationHelper.executeSQL, InventInventoryDataServiceQueueProcessHelper.deleteStatusReady). Following the gate literally would push an agent to abandon a correct, MS-idiomatic implementation.
suggested_fix_area: src/tools/validation (reference resolver): seed a kernel/system-symbol allowlist (X++ system classes + system enums: Connection, UserConnection, Statement, ResultSet, ResultSetMetaData, SqlParams, SqlSystem, SqlDataDictionary, DictTable, DictField, DbBackend, CodeAccessPermission, SqlStatementExecutePermission, SqlDataDictionaryPermission, ...) so they resolve instead of erroring, or at minimum downgrade unknown-type/unknown-static-member to a warning when the receiver is not in the index at all (as opposed to present-but-missing-member) and stop reporting "checked inheritance chain and extensions" for a type that was never found.
